certifiedResults.title: South Dakota SOS 2024 General Election Canvass and Certificate
certifiedResults.detail: Presidential county totals are parsed from the official South Dakota Secretary of State canvass and certificate PDF for the 2024 General Election.
certifiedResults.sourceTimestampBasis: Official South Dakota SOS election-history page links the 2024 General Election Canvass and Certificate.

wardDetail.title: South Dakota partial precinct review rows
wardDetail.detail: Official South Dakota Secretary of State grouped county canvass PDFs contain precinct presidential rows. The parser loads vote-share-only local rows for counties whose OCR-extracted precinct rows reconcile exactly to certified county presidential totals: Aurora, Bennett, Brown, Hand, Potter, and Todd.
wardDetail.sourceTimestampBasis: Official grouped county canvass PDFs are linked from the South Dakota SOS 2024 election-history page; local rows are accepted only after reconciling to certified county presidential totals.

turnout.title: South Dakota official county turnout
turnout.detail: Official South Dakota SOS Election Returns and Registration Figures PDF. The importer reads the 2024 General Election Voter Turnout table, captures county registered voters and votes cast, and validates against the published statewide totals.
turnout.sourceTimestampBasis: Official South Dakota SOS Election Returns and Registration Figures PDF for the 2024 General Election.
